import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    b = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    k = p[6] + p[7]/T
    return a + b*np.exp(-k*eps) + p[8]*np.sqrt(eps) + p[9]*eps

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    b = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    k = np.exp(p[6] + p[7]/T)

    return a + b*(1-np.exp(-k*eps**m)) + p[9]*np.log(eps)

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    d = p[3] + p[4]*T
    n = p[5] + p[6]*T

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    X = np.exp(-p[2]/T)
    a = p[0] + p[1]*X
    d = p[3] + p[4]*X
    return a + d*eps**p[5] + p[6]*eps + p[7]*np.sqrt(eps) + p[8]*np.log(eps) + p[9]*X*eps
